entries.prompt: Create a precise high-fidelity RDF4J Workbench page design board with a large desktop page at left and a narrow 390px mobile rendition at right. Reference1 is this exact existing page for real fields/data/actions; reference2 is the approved new design visual language. Preserve functional labels and workflows from reference1, but replace its grey gradient, orange rule, tiny native widgets, cobalt links and fixed mobile sidebar. Use slate #f1f5f9 canvas, white islands radius12 with subtle soft shadows, #f8fafc inset sections, #0f172a titles, #334155 navigation/secondary actions, #64748b muted text, #e2e8f0 dividers, #cbd5e1 controls. Teal #0f766e primary actions and content URI links; no blue links anywhere. Orange only in original RDF4J logo. Header small logo at left, readable server/repository/user context at right; slate Change links. Sidebar200px white island with consistent18px outline icons and selected page slate fill/left rule, main area flexible with24px gap/gutters. UI font14px, page title24px, island title16px. Labelled inputs/selects above fields,36px desktop44px mobile controls,8px radius,16px outline action icons. Mobile header context wraps, Menu disclosure closed above title, fullwidth fields stacked,16px gutters, no clipped text or horizontal page scrollbar. No phone frames, no decorative art, no invented features/statistics/confirmation steps. Treat all pages as ONE consistent application. Desktop page should use space proportionate to task: short forms cap field width around600px, tables use full available width; avoid enormous empty white cards. Retain real footer.  Mobile must use the approved mobile reference literally: context stays readable below logo, a separate labelled Menu disclosure row sits below header and above page title; do NOT replace it with a tiny unlabelled hamburger in the header. Use the same shell on every page. Change/submit action must sit OUTSIDE any optional disclosure, so usable when closed.  Page-specific contract: Explore. Title is simply Explore, with current resource URI as wrapping monospace context below it and existing range 1–4 of4 as modest metadata. First compact form island: Resource input with actual <http://example.org/people/alice>. Keep Enter submission behavior, no invented action. Results island uses four columns Subject/Predicate/Object/Context, muted teal URI links and ink literals preserving links. Collapsed Result options exposes page size, datatypes plus shared Layout Auto/Table/Records and Wrap values; shown open as a clearly labelled separate component inset. Pagination below table. Mobile Auto presents complete labelled Subject/Predicate/Object/Context records with wrapping, not horizontal scroll. Resource input fullwidth. Full screen for results can reuse query result view mode if shared, no rerun.
